scripts.dev: pnpm build:coding && pnpm --filter @mlx-studio/desktop tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.check: pnpm tokens:check && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:format && pnpm check:frontend && pnpm check:runtime && pnpm check:coding && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.check:runtime: uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 ruff check services/runtime/src tests scripts/generate_coding_rpc.py scripts/verify_local_speech.py scripts/verify_release_bundle.py scripts/seed_acceptance_database.py scripts/verify_speech_quality.py scripts/verify_local_edit.py scripts/preview_release.py scripts/publish_preview_release.py && uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 pyright --pythonpath services/runtime/.venv/bin/python services/runtime/src
scripts.check:boundaries: uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 python scripts/generate_coding_rpc.py --check && node --test scripts/check-boundaries.spec.mjs && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-source-quality.mjs
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:runtime && pnpm test:coding && pnpm test:acceptance
scripts.test:runtime: pnpm build:coding && PYTHONPATH=services/runtime/src uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.build:runtime:check: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; [compile(p.read_text(), str(p), "exec") for p in Path("services/runtime/src").rglob("*.py")]'
scripts.build:app: pnpm build:coding:bundle && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:sidecar && CI=true pnpm --filter @mlx-studio/desktop tauri build --ci
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --project services/runtime --frozen --extra mlx-vlm --extra mflux --extra audio
